tips.title: Know your exact location
tips.text: Be ready to describe your street, barangay, and nearby landmarks when you call for help.

tips.title: Save these numbers now
tips.text: Add 911, 117, and 143 to your phone today — before an emergency happens.

tips.title: Stay calm and clear
tips.text: Speak slowly, answer the dispatcher’s questions, and stay on the line until told otherwise.

tips.title: Keep an emergency kit
tips.text: Prepare water, non-perishable food, a flashlight, batteries, and first-aid supplies at home.

service.title: Health Services
service.subtitle: Health programs and assistance from the Municipal Health Office of Getafe.
service.intro: The Municipal Health Office provides accessible primary health care and social health programs to protect and improve the well-being of every resident.

services.name: Health Cards / PhilHealth
services.desc: Registration and renewal of health card benefits and PhilHealth membership.

services.name: Vaccination Programs
services.desc: Immunization for infants, children, and adults, including routine and catch-up vaccines.

services.name: Medical Assistance
services.desc: Financial assistance for medical treatment, consultations, and hospitalization.

services.name: Maternal & Child Health
services.desc: Prenatal, natal, and postnatal care for mothers and their children.

services.name: Senior Citizen & PWD Benefits
services.desc: Health and social benefits for senior citizens and persons with disabilities.
requirements: Senior Citizen ID or PWD ID

steps.text: Visit the Municipal Health Office (MHO) or the Rural Health Unit.
Present your ID and the required documents.
Register for the program or service you need.
Receive guidance on your benefits and schedule.

service.title: Certificates & IDs
service.subtitle: Official certificates, clearances, and identification documents for residents.
service.intro: From barangay clearances to resident certificates, the municipality issues the documents you need for work, school, and personal transactions.

services.name: Barangay Clearance
services.desc: A certification that you are a resident of the barangay with no derogatory record.

services.name: Barangay ID
services.desc: An identification card issued to verified residents of the barangay.

services.name: Certificate of Indigency
services.desc: A certification that you qualify for financial assistance or government programs.

services.name: Local Residency Certificate
services.desc: Certifies that you have been residing in Getafe for a given period.
requirements: Proof of residence (billing statement or lease)

services.name: Community Tax Certificate (Cedula)
services.desc: The annual residence and occupation tax certificate issued by the municipality.

steps.text: Visit your barangay hall or the Municipal Civil Registrar’s Office.
Present the required documents and fill out the application form.
Pay the applicable certification or processing fee.

service.title: Education & Scholarships
service.subtitle: Financial assistance, scholarships, and skills training programs for Getafe residents.
service.intro: The municipality invests in its students and workforce through scholarships, financial aid, and skills training designed to open more opportunities for every Getafe\u00f1o.

services.name: Municipal Scholarship Program
services.desc: Financial support for deserving college students who are residents of Getafe.
requirements: Certificate of Indigency (if applying for aid)

services.name: School Assistance / Financial Aid
services.desc: One-time assistance for school needs such as uniforms, supplies, and transportation.

services.name: Skills Training Programs
services.desc: Short-term skills and livelihood training, including TESDA-accredited courses.

services.name: Alternative Learning System
services.desc: A program for out-of-school youth and adults to continue their basic education.

steps.text: Secure a Barangay Clearance from your barangay.
Visit the Municipal Social Welfare and Development (MSWD) office.
Submit the scholarship or assistance requirements and application form.
Await evaluation and the release of benefits or training schedule.

service.title: Barangay Clearance
service.subtitle: Certificate & Clearance · All barangays in Getafe
service.intro: A Barangay Clearance confirms that you are a resident or have a stated purpose within the barangay. Prepare the items below before visiting your barangay hall.

services.name: Required documents
services.desc: Bring the following items for verification. The barangay office may request additional documents depending on your purpose.
requirements: Payment for the applicable barangay fee

steps.text: Visit your barangay Barangay Hall during office hours.
Ask for the Barangay Clearance application form and complete it accurately.
Submit your ID and any supporting document for verification.
Confirm the applicable fee and pay through the barangay office.
Review the details on your clearance before receiving it.

sections.title: Information we collect
sections.body: We may collect personal information that you voluntarily provide when you use our online services, such as your name, contact details, and information required to process applications for permits, certificates, and other government transactions.

sections.title: How we use your information
sections.body: Information collected is used solely to deliver, process, and improve government services, respond to inquiries, and comply with legal and regulatory obligations. We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information.

sections.title: Data protection
sections.body: The Municipality of Getafe is committed to protecting your personal data in accordance with the Data Privacy Act of 2012 (RA 10173). We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to safeguard your information against unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction.

sections.title: Cookies and analytics
sections.body: Our website may use cookies and similar technologies to improve your browsing experience and gather aggregate statistics about site usage. You may adjust your browser settings to refuse cookies; however, some features may not function properly as a result.

sections.title: Third-party links
sections.body: Our website may contain links to external websites, including national government portals. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of these external sites and encourage you to review their respective privacy policies.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: Under the Data Privacy Act, you have the right to be informed, to access, to object, to rectify, and to erase your personal data, as well as to file a complaint with the National Privacy Commission. To exercise these rights, you may contact our Data Protection Officer.

sections.title: Acceptance of terms
sections.body: By accessing or using the official web portal of the Municipality of Getafe, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Use. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, please discontinue use of the portal.

sections.title: Use of the portal
sections.body: The portal is provided for lawful purposes, including accessing government information and availing of municipal services. You agree not to misuse the portal, attempt to gain unauthorized access, or use it in any way that disrupts its operation.

sections.title: Accuracy of information
sections.body: The Municipality of Getafe strives to keep the information on this portal accurate and up to date. However, information is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. Users should verify critical information with the concerned municipal office.

sections.title: Intellectual property
sections.body: Content published on this portal, including text, graphics, logos, and the municipal seal, is the property of the Municipality of Getafe unless otherwise stated and may not be reproduced without appropriate authorization.

sections.title: External links
sections.body: This portal may contain links to third-party websites. The Municipality of Getafe does not endorse and is not responsible for the content or practices of external sites.

sections.title: Limitation of liability
sections.body: The Municipality of Getafe shall not be held liable for any loss or damage arising from the use of, or reliance on, information obtained through this portal, to the fullest extent permitted by law.

sections.title: Changes to these terms
sections.body: We may update these Terms of Use from time to time. Continued use of the portal after any changes constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.

sections.title: Essential cookies
sections.body: The portal uses an essential session cookie to keep you signed in and protect authenticated requests. It is HttpOnly and is not used for advertising or cross-site tracking. Sign-in and citizen services may not work if essential cookies are blocked.

sections.title: Google sign-in
sections.body: If you choose Google sign-in or sign-up, Google and this portal use temporary authentication state to complete the secure sign-in exchange. The temporary state is cleared when the exchange finishes or expires.

sections.title: Caching and private data
sections.body: Public, versioned website assets may be cached to improve loading speed. Account pages, authentication responses, citizen records, and other private API responses are marked no-store so browsers and shared caches should not retain them.

sections.title: Your choices
sections.body: You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Blocking essential cookies may prevent sign-in, account access, and other protected services from working. The portal does not require non-essential advertising cookies.
